S3E4c6-L15.back: So you don't think my condition is too serious?

S3E4c6-L16.mt: አይደለም፣ ሁኔታችሁ በጣም ከባድ አይደለም። ጉዳቱን መቀነስ ብቻ ያስፈልጋችኋል።

S3E4c6-L19.back: This is a very important time. If you want to call her, go buy shoes or wash. If you want her to come back, you have to pretend you don't care.

S3E4c6-L2.mt: በመጨረሻም እሷን አገኘኋት፤ እሷም ግንኙነታችን በጣም በፍጥነት እየተጓዘ እንደሆነና መረጋጋት እንደሚያስፈልገን ነገረችኝ።
S3E4c6-L2.back: I finally met her, and she told me that our relationship was going very fast and we needed some calm.

S3E4c6-L21.mt: ከእሷ ጋር ተገናኝተሽ አደጋ እንደሆነ አድርገሽ ታሳያለሽ ከዚያም ግድ እንደሌለህ አድርጊ
S3E4c6-L21.back: I'm gonna make you pretend that you're in danger and then pretend you don't care.

S3E4c6-L23.mt: ውዴ፣ አንተ ሙሉ በሙሉ ተሸናፊ አይደለህም።
S3E4c6-L23.back: Well, you're not a complete loser.

S1E16c15-L11.mt: እርሷ ክፉ ናት ማለቴ አይደለም ነገር ግን ሁሌም እቃዎቼን ታበላሻለች ስምንት ዓመት ሲሆነኝ የካርቱን ቴርሞዜን አልሰጠኋትም ስለዚህ በአውቶቡስ ስር ጣላት እውነተኛ አውቶቡስ
S1E16c15-L11.back: I don't mean she's evil, but she always spoils my things. When I was eight years old, I didn't give her a cardboard thermos, so I threw her under a real bus.

S1E16c15-L13.mt: ለኔ እሱ ያ ነው እሷም ሰረቀችው ልቡን ሰበረችኝ ከዚያም እኔን ማናገር አቆመ ከሁለታችንም ጋር የሚመሳሰል ነገር አጠገብ መሆን እንደማይፈልግ ነገረኝ
S1E16c15-L13.back: He's the one for me. She stole my heart. She broke my heart. He stopped talking to me. He told me he didn't want to be around anything like us.

S1E16c15-L15.mt: ጆይ የወንድ ጓደኛዬ ወይም ቴርሞሴ ወይም ሌላ ነገር እንዳልሆነ አውቃለሁ፣ ግን...
S1E16c15-L15.back: Joey, I know it's not my boyfriend or a thermos or anything, but...

S1E16c15-L21.mt: እባካችሁ፣ ከአንድ ሳምንት በፊት ነው የተገናኙት፣ ገና ተኝተው አያውቁም።
S1E16c15-L21.back: Please, they met a week ago, they haven't slept yet.

S1E16c15-L25.back: Yes, hello, can we help you, ma'am?

S1E16c15-L3.back: It's very good except for a little advice once you're in this situation, don't leave your hand on the table.

S2E24c4-L15.back: Not a dog bed, but a baby bed.

S3E11c11-L24.mt: 'ለምን አትደውልለትም?' በጣም አመሰግናለሁ! አሁን ሐኪሙ የወንድ ጓደኛውን ከመቁረጡ በፊት ታካሚውን እንደሚያዘጋጅ ሁሉ እሱም ታካሚዋን ያዘጋጃታል!
S3E11c11-L24.back: 'Why don't you call him?' Thank you very much! Now he prepares his patient just as a doctor prepares his patient before he cuts his boyfriend!

S3E12c1-L20.back: No, it's a bag, with a thermos inside.

S3E12c1-L24.mt: አልበርት ጓደኞች የሉትም ነገር ግን በፓርቲው በጣም ተደስቷል

S3E12c1-L26.back: Okay if the observer can open my beer with his back.

S3E4c6-L10.mt: ወደ ጨለማው ዋሻ ጎናችን እንኳን ደህና መጣችሁ።
S3E4c6-L10.back: Welcome to our dark cave side.

S3E4c6-L11.mt: ይህ አይስክሬም እንደ ቆሻሻ ጣዕም አለው።
S3E4c6-L11.back: This ice cream tastes like garbage.

S3E4c6-L12.mt: እውነተኛውን አይስክሬም ለሞት የተዳረጉ ታካሚዎች እናስቀምጣለን።

S3E4c6-L13.mt: ወንዶች ዘወትር ሲጎዱሽ፣ ዝቅተኛ ቅባት ባለው አይስክሬም መጠቀም አለብሽ።
S3E4c6-L13.back: If men always hurt you, you should use low-fat ice cream.

S3E4c6-L15.back: So you're saying I'm not going to die?

S3E4c6-L16.mt: አይደለም፣ የምትሞትበት ደረጃ ላይ አይደለህም። አስቸኳይ ሕክምና ብቻ ያስፈልግሃል።
S3E4c6-L16.back: No, you are not dying. You only need emergency treatment.

S3E4c6-L19.mt: ይህ ወሳኝ ጊዜ ነው። እጅህ ስልኩን እንደምትይዝ ከተሰማህ፣ ጫማ ለመግዛት ትሄዳለህ፣ ወደ ቡናማ መታጠቢያ ትገባለህ። እሷን መልሰህ ማግኘት ከፈለግህ ግድ እንደሌለህ አድርገህ መቅረብ አለብህ።
S3E4c6-L19.back: This is a crucial moment. If you feel like your hand is holding the phone, you go to buy shoes, you go to the brown bathroom. You have to act like you don't care if you want to get her back.

S3E4c6-L2.mt: ስለዚህ በመጨረሻ አገኘኋት፣ እናም ግንኙነታችን በጣም በፍጥነት እየሄደ ነው እና ማዘግየት አለብን አለችኝ።
S3E4c6-L2.back: So I finally met her, and she said our relationship is going very fast and we have to slow down.

S3E4c6-L21.mt: ስለዚህ በአጋጣሚ ታገኛታለህ፣ ግን ሆን ብለህ፣ ከዚያም ግድ እንደሌለህ አድርገህ ታደርጋለህ።
S3E4c6-L21.back: So you find her by chance, but intentionally, and then you pretend you don't care.

S3E4c6-L23.mt: ውዴ፣ አንተ ሙሉ በሙሉ አሳዛኝ አይደለህም።

S3E4c6-L24.back: I asked her if I could lose her.

S3E4c6-L5.mt: ከዚያም እንደ አንድ አሳዛኝ ቡችላ ችግረኛና ተለጣፊ ሆንኩ።
S3E4c6-L5.back: Then I became like a miserable puppy, disabled and stuck.

S1E16c15-L11.mt: Eeyyee, ilaalaa, ani ishee hamaa ykn waan akkanaa akka taate hin jedhu. Isheen yeroo hunda wantoota koo cabsiteetti. Yommuu umriin koo waggaa saddeet taʼu, aniis ishiidhaaf termosii Juudii Jeetsan akkan hin kennineef atoobisicha jala darbite.
S1E16c15-L11.back: When I was eight years old, I threw myself under the bus so that I wouldn't give her a Judy Jetson thermometer.
S1E16c15-L11.back_madlad: Yeah, baby, I don't think she's a bad girl or anything like that; she was always scared of me, and when I was three years old, I gave her a Judy Garland thermos and covered it with a toothpick.

S1E16c15-L13.mt: Haa taʼu malee, inni anaaf kan ture kana ture, isheenis akka waan tokkootti isa fudhatteetti, achiis... garaa isaa cabsiteetti... achiis na haasofsiisuu dhiisteetti.
S1E16c15-L13.back: But that's what he was to me, and she took him for granted, and then... she broke her heart... and stopped talking to me.
S1E16c15-L13.back_madlad: "However, that was what it was for me, and she took it as a thing of the past, and she stopped ... she stopped laughing ... she stopped laughing at me.

S1E16c15-L21.mt: Akkan si gaafadhu, torban tokkoof wal arganiiru.

S1E16c15-L21.back_madlad: As I asked, he took a week's medicine.

S1E22c5-L16.mt: Hundi isaanii malee... hundi isaanii miti.

S1E22c5-L16.back_madlad: But their heads... not their heads.

S2E21c5-L5.back: Hey, isn't that the man who used your leather?
S2E21c5-L5.back_madlad: Hehehe, is this the guy who used your mouthpiece?

S2E24c4-L2.back: Perhaps that is why babies learn to talk.

S2E24c4-L21.back: You know, we don't have to talk about that right now, but in fact, I'm talking about a time when airplanes and birds will dominate the earth.
S2E24c4-L21.back_madlad: This is a good thing, but we know that it is not necessary to talk about it; in fact, in the future, the ships and shipyards will be destroyed.

S2E24c4-L3.back: Let me ask you a question.

S2E24c4-L9.mt: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati baayʼee gammadaa jirta.
S2E24c4-L9.back_madlad: O God, you are so gracious.

S2E2c2-L17.back_madlad: Going to Bloomingdale's with Jolie was similar to going to Rachel's wedding in her hometown.

S2E2c2-L19.back_madlad: May he kill you as he kills the horses on the road.

S2E2c2-L2.mt: Eeyyee, isa kam akka taʼe hin beeku.
S2E2c2-L2.back: Yes, I do not know which one.
S2E2c2-L2.back_madlad: Yeah, I didn't know he was.

S2E2c2-L22.back: I am so happy for you, Monica.
S2E2c2-L22.back_madlad: When I'm so upset, I'm sorry.

S2E2c2-L7.back: Oh, listen, a friend of mine who works at Bloomingdale's has to quit tomorrow, and he wants to take advantage of his pay cut.
S2E2c2-L7.back_madlad: Oh, listen, my friend who works at Bloomingdale's has to stop working, and she also wants to use her haircut.

S2E2c2-L8.mt: Anis hin dandaʼu, akkoo koo gara ogeessa fayyaa bineensotaatti geessuu qaba.
S2E2c2-L8.back: I can't either, so I have to take my grandmother to the vet.
S2E2c2-L8.back_madlad: I couldn't, so I had to go to a doctor.

S3E11c11-L10.mt: Wantoonni gaariin kun dhugaa dha, ani kanan jedhe kana dha.
S3E11c11-L10.back: These good things are true, that's what I said.
S3E11c11-L10.back_madlad: These are the good things that are true, that is what I say.
